456773.overview: Vegetable Crush is a Galaxian clone that offers the same basic gameplay; the player shoots down a wave of carrots, apples, and eggplants that occasionally drop down and shoot projectiles at the player. Sometimes they do so in formations. Other times, one vegetable comes down. They might come down once and settle down afterwards, or continue to come down until they are destroyed. If they or their shots come into contact with the player, they'll lose a life, and the game will be over if all lives are lost.
